reviews.text:
This serum is so good for my skin! My friend told me that they don't see apparent signs of my aging, and I'm 45 , they made me compliments. 
So seems worth to continue using it!
reviews.zh:
呢支精華真係好啱我膚質！朋友話睇唔到我有明顯嘅老化迹象，而家我45歲，朋友都讚我。
睇嚟真係值得繼續用落去！

reviews.text: Amazing hydrating serum! I've been using it for a few weeks and my skin feels much more hydrated, smoother, and healthier. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. The capsules melt into the skin easily and leave a beautiful glow. It works well under makeup and doesn't cause irritation. I would definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 保濕精華勁讚！用咗幾星期之後，皮膚感覺更加保濕、更滑、更健康。質地輕盈，好快就吸收晒，唔會黏笠。膠囊好容易就溶入皮膚，留低好靚嘅光澤。搽完化妝都好貼，亦都唔會刺激皮膚。一定會回購！

reviews.text: Great serum, I'm ordering it for the third time in a row and will continue to order and use it. The skin definitely looks healthier, more pleasant, smoother. Together with the moisturizer from the same series, it's simply a winning combination.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅精華，呢個已經係我連續第三次回購，會繼續訂繼續用。皮膚明顯望落健康咗、更舒服、更滑。配合同系列嘅保濕霜一齊用，簡直係無敵組合。

reviews.text: The Serum I wanted to try. Great consistency. It's great for moisturizing and nourishing the skin. I really like this series with Pdrn. I've tried almost all the products.
reviews.zh: 一直想試呢支精華。質地好好。保濕同滋養皮膚效果一流。真心鍾意呢個 Pdrn 系列。我幾乎試勻成個系列嘅產品。

reviews.text: I am completely blown away by the Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum. The texture starts out incredibly lightweight and watery, but as you rub it in, it forms a comforting, luxurious veil of moisture that sinks beautifully into the skin. It features microcapsule technology that delivers PDRN (Salmon DNA), 3% Hyaluronic Acid, and Hydrolyzed Collagen. This powerful trio doesn't just sit on the surface; it intensely plumps up dehydration lines and leaves behind an instant, radiant, wet-looking glow without any sticky or greasy residue. It has quickly become my favorite skin prepper because it makes my makeup lay down flawlessly.
reviews.zh: 我完全被 Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 震撼到。質地一開始係超輕盈、水感十足，但慢慢推開之後，就會形成一層舒適奢華嘅保濕薄膜，好靚咁滲入皮膚。佢採用微囊科技，注入 PDRN（鮭魚 DNA）、3% 透明質酸同水解膠原。呢個強勁嘅鐵三角唔止停留喺表面；更可以即時撐起缺水紋，留低即時、具光澤、水潤感十足嘅光感，完全唔會有黏笠或者油笠嘅殘留感。佢已經迅速成為我最愛嘅妝前打底，因為令到我嘅妝容貼服到完美。

reviews.text: It is really good that I always use before makeup, it’s really liquid and not sticky, and moisture enough for my really dry skin, it helps a lot to get a good makeup look. And stay hydrated for a day.
reviews.zh: 真係好好，我化妝前一定會用，質地非常水潤，唔會黏笠，保濕力對我呢塊極乾皮膚嚟講都好足夠，幫助我化出好嘅妝容。仲可以keep住全日水潤。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+1ml*10ea)
reviews.text: One of the most hydrating yet nourishing and moisturizing serums I’ve tried! You only need a few drops for the entire face and it gives such a beautiful glow. It almost feels like a hydrating oil, very comforting for the winter months.
reviews.zh: 係我用過最保濕同時最滋潤嘅精華之一！成塊面用幾滴就夠，俾到好靚嘅光澤。感覺幾乎似保濕油，冬天用好治癒。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+1ml*10ea)
reviews.text: Comencé a usar las ampollas, son súper hidratantes, no se absorbe muy rápido pero por la hidratación que deja no importa, usualmente aplico una crema humectante después del suero porque mi piel es seca, sin embargo con este producto no lo necesite y en la rutina de la mañana aplique el bloqueador después. Espero ver resultados pronto.
reviews.zh: 我開始用呢啲膠囊，超級保濕，唔算吸收得好快，但睇佢俾到嘅保濕度就唔介意喇，通常我都會喺精華之後再加保濕霜，因為我皮膚乾，不過用咗呢個產品之後就唔需要加，而喺早上嘅流程我就跟住搽防曬。希望好快見到效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
